provided.title: File:Skyline of Nairobi city as seen from the lake in Uhuru Park.jpg

observed.caption: A calm lake in a park with palm trees and people along the shore, with a city skyline of high-rise buildings under an overcast sky in the background.
observed.description: In the foreground a large still lake reflects the cloudy sky and surrounding trees. A grassy shoreline with scattered trees including several tall palm trees runs across the middle of the image, with numerous small figures of people standing and walking along the water's edge. Behind the park an elevated roadway is partially visible among the trees, and beyond that a city skyline rises with multiple high-rise buildings of varying shapes and colors including a tall brown glass tower on the right, blue glass twin towers near the center, a cylindrical tower, and a clock tower. The sky above is heavily overcast with gray and white clouds, and the lighting is soft and diffused.
